setup: const { ColossusLab } = await import('/src/dev/colossus_lab.js'); const lab = new ColossusLab(g); window.__lab = lab; lab.cutWorld(-600, -50, -900, 600, 200, -186); const b = await lab.build('tordo'); lab.place(b, 0, 0, -1, Math.PI); lab.atmo('fire', { density: 0.0115, far: 220 }); window.__colTick = (dt) => lab.tick(dt); g.player.spawn(-24, 0, 1, 1.4); return { ms: b.ms, info: b.info };
